title: A piece is a whole thought
text: A piece is a whole thought (confirmed 2026-11-25: "Sounds right"). 28 of v4's edges sat in running speech with no pause; some split a Thai word the engine had split ("กลัวน้ำตา | ไหล"), and v4 opened on "เพราะ | อยู่ในเรื่องนี้". Fun moments added as 1-3 s bits had the same problem; the user kept them whole or not at all.
